death.attack.animus_extended.arcane.play: %1$s was unmade by arcane power whilst fighting %2$s
message.animus_extended.soul_phoenix.rev: The Phoenix rises from your ashes!
tooltip.animus_extended.sigil_holding_gr: Holds up to 9 sigils - scroll to switch
tooltip.animus_extended.sigil_holding_su: Holds up to 18 sigils - scroll to switch
tooltip.neovitae.sigil.archmage.desc: Fires three homing arcane missiles that ignore all defenses
tooltip.neovitae.sigil.berserk.desc: Land 10 hits within 15 seconds to gain Strength III; hits grant Speed

tooltip.neovitae.sigil.bullet_time.desc: Slows mobs and projectiles around you for 10 seconds

tooltip.neovitae.sigil.vein_seeker.desc: Reveals nearby ores through walls for 10 seconds
tooltip.neovitae.sigil.warding_gale.desc: Pushes hostile mobs away and deflects incoming projectiles
